verdict.rationale: Superpowers lets an agent work autonomously for long stretches once you say "go": subagent-driven development dispatches and reviews tasks, can run 'a couple hours at a time' without deviating from the plan, and records rulings on non-catastrophic ambiguities and keeps going (gh-6, gh-10, gh-18, docs-2). However, this is supervised in-session execution that requires approval before implementation, not user-configured automations running in the background (docs-56). Missing for 10: scheduled, triggered or background automation setup, runs detached from an interactive session, and independent hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.
